title: Feedback
description: The user's verdict on a finished flow run, saved as <run>/feedback.yaml under the root key "feedback". Read by `stack stats`.

verdict.description: useful = used as is; partial = used after changes or only in part; not-useful = not used.

wrong.description: Findings in report.md the user judged wrong or not worth acting on, by number (F1, F2…).

note.description: The user's own words, when they gave any.

at.description: ISO timestamp, taken from the shell.
